#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <cctype>
#include <regex>

using namespace std;

int readInt() {
    int c = getchar();
    while (isspace(c)) {
        if (c == EOF) throw ios_base::failure("Input mismatch");
        c = getchar();
    }
    int sgn = 1;
    if (c == '-') {
        sgn = -1;
        c = getchar();
    }
    int res = 0;
    do {
        if (!isdigit(c)) throw ios_base::failure("Input mismatch");
        res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
        c = getchar();
    } while (!isspace(c));
    return res * sgn;
}

string readString() {
    int c = getchar();
    while (isspace(c)) {
        if (c == EOF) throw ios_base::failure("Input mismatch");
        c = getchar();
    }
    string res;
    do {
        res.push_back(c);
        c = getchar();
    } while (!isspace(c));
    return res;
}

int main() {
    int n = readInt();
    string st = readString();
    string part = st.substr(0, n);

    int a1 = 0;
    string outside = regex_replace(part, regex("\\([^)]*\\)?"), "_");
    istringstream iss(outside);
    string token;
    while (getline(iss, token, '_')) {
        if (token.length() > (size_t)a1) a1 = token.length();
    }

    int a2 = 0;
    regex re("\\(([^)]*)\\)?");
    sregex_iterator it(part.begin(), part.end(), re);
    sregex_iterator end;
    while (it != end) {
        string group = (*it)[1];
        if (group.length() > 0) a2++;
        ++it;
    }

    cout << a1 << " " << a2 << endl;
    return 0;
}
